lines: Tassatthā parihāyantīti tassa tathārūpassa puggalassa diṭṭhadhammikādibhedā atthā kāḷapakkhe candimā viya, parihāyanti divase divase parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gacchanti.
Mittehi ca virujjhatīti “evaṃ paṭipajja, mā evaṃ paṭipajjā”ti ovādadāyakehi kalyāṇamittehi “avacanīyā mayan”ti ovādassa anādāneneva viruddho nāma hoti.

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave puññāni karonto buddhasuññe loke candabhāgāya nadiyā tīre kinnarayoniyaṃ nibbatto.
Ekadivasaṃ aññataraṃ paccekabuddhaṃ disvā pasannamānaso vanditvā katañjalī ajjunapupphehi pūjaṃ akāsi.

So tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddhuppāde kulagehe nibbattitvā sambhūtoti laddhanāmo vayappatto bhagavato parinibbānassa pacchā dhammabhaṇḍāgārikassa santike dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā samaṇadhammaṃ karonto vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Sukhette vappitaṃ bījaṃ, sayambhumhi aho mama.

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Arahattaṃ pana patvā vimuttisukhena viharanto vassasataparinibbute bhagavati vesālikesu vajjiputtakesu dasa vatthūni paggayha ṭhitesu kākaṇḍakaputtena yasattherena ussāhitehi sattasatehi khīṇāsavehi taṃ diṭṭhiṃ bhinditvā saddhammaṃ paggaṇhantehi dhammavinayasaṅgahe kate tesaṃ vajjiputtakānaṃ uddhammaubbinayadīpane dhammasaṃvegena thero –

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Yaso kittiñca pappoti, mittehi na virujjhatī”ti.

before.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “kappati nu kho, na nu kho kappatī”ti vinayakukkucce uppanne yāva viyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ pucchitvā taṃ kukkuccaṃ na vinodeti, tāva dandhakāle tassa kiccassa dandhāyitabbasamaye tarati madditvā vītikkamaṃ karoti.
Taraṇīye ca dandhayeti gahaṭṭhassa tāva saraṇagamanasīlasamādānādike, pabbajitassa vattapaṭivattakaraṇādike samathavipassanānuyoge ca taritabbe sampatte sīghaṃ taṃ kiccaṃ ananuyuñjitvā –
“āgamanamāse pakkhe vā karissāmī”ti dandhāyeyya, taṃ kiccaṃ akarontova kālaṃ vītināmeyya.
Ayonisaṃvidhānenāti evaṃ dandhāyitabbe taranto taritabbe ca dandhāyanto anupāyasaṃvidhānena upāyasaṃvidhānābhāvena bālo, mandabuddhiko puggalo, sampati āyatiñca dukkhaṃ anatthaṃ pāpuṇāti.

after.title: Sambhūtattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “tarati dandhaye” tipadānaṃ atthabhāvena bhāvanācittassa paggahaniggahe uddharanti.
Purimā hi dve gāthā pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya caritabbaṃ samaṇadhammaṃ akatvā kukkuccapakatatāya dasa vatthūni dīpetvā saṅghena nikkaḍḍhite vajjiputtake sandhāya therena vuttā.
Pacchimā pana attasadise sammā paṭipanne sakatthaṃ nipphādetvā ṭhiteti.
